engineering_agent.name: FTSE Engineering Agent
engineering_agent.cadence: Dispatched by engineering-queue when an open task is ready

engineering_queue.name: FTSE Engineering Queue
engineering_queue.cadence: Hourly weekday processor (:15 UTC via external cron; GitHub schedule backup). Marks merged engineering PRs, then dispatches engineering-agent when the queue has open tasks and no engineering PR is in flight. Also runs on engineering PR merge.

dashboard_bridge.name: Dashboard bridge worker
dashboard_bridge.cadence: Weekday every 10m UTC — **primary: cron-job.org** (import_cron_jobs.py --job dashboard-bridge). GitHub schedule */10 is backup only and often drifts hours. Polls Supabase dashboard_commands and repository_dispatches target workflows. docs/ops/dashboard-bridge.md.

ingest_loop.name: FTSE Ingest Loop
ingest_loop.cadence: Mon–Fri 07:05 + 10:05 UTC deepen; Saturday 20:05 + 23:05 UTC pre-Sunday deepen (drain cap 6) so Sunday email-report can send without OCR burn. External cron: docs/ops/orchestrator-cron.md; design: docs/ops/ingest-scan-then-target.md#saturday-pre-sunday-deepen.

universe_filing_archive_pack.name: Universe filing archive pack
universe_filing_archive_pack.cadence: Mon–Fri 22:00 UTC quiet-window cold archive lane under archive_lane_gate (week-first then backward pack plan). Preemptible; suspends while focus fat sprint active. Writes bottleneck review (observe-only). docs/ops/universe-filing-archive-pack.md.

analysis_review.name: Modelling analysis review
analysis_review.cadence: Sunday 08:30 UTC GitHub backup; **primary: cron-job.org** 35 10 * * 0 (optional 35 12) after email bundle. Read-only synthesis over backtest/sim/historical analysis and paper learning tracks. docs/ops/analysis-review.md; scheduling: docs/ops/orchestrator-cron.md.

paper_learning_review.name: Paper learning churn review
paper_learning_review.cadence: Optional observe-only churn/cost agent synthesis. Disable via docs/data/paper_automation/review_policy.json. docs/ops/paper-learning-review.md

learning_director.name: Learning Director review
learning_director.cadence: Sunday 10:55 UTC after paper-learning-review; **primary: cron-job.org** 55 10 * * 0. Observe-only regime/convergence/vision synthesis. Disable via docs/data/paper_automation/review_policy.json. docs/ops/learning-director.md; scheduling: docs/ops/orchestrator-cron.md.

ops_monitor.name: FTSE Ops Monitor
ops_monitor.cadence: Daily 07:45 UTC morning + 13:15 UTC catch-up (GitHub schedule + external cron). Workflow/artifact health, safe auto-fixes, re-verify; SMTP deferred until day's slots complete when only pre-slot/recovery findings remain. docs/ops/ops-monitor.md.

ci_main_nightly.name: CI main nightly
ci_main_nightly.cadence: Daily 07:30 UTC full pytest on main (GitHub schedule + external cron). Catches latent test coupling to docs/data commits that skip push CI. Failures draft ci-fix tasks via ci-fix-responder. docs/ops/ci-fix-automation.md.

data_backup.name: FTSE Data Backup
data_backup.cadence: Sunday 12:30 UTC after email bundle; **primary: cron-job.org** 30 12 * * 0. Tier-1 docs/data tarball + manifest; GitHub artifact (90d), chunked SMTP email to BACKUP_EMAIL_TO, optional S3 via BACKUP_S3_URI. docs/ops/data-backup.md.
